# How Do I Build a Farm Management System Without a Developer?


You build it by describing your farm in plain text, fields, crops, inputs, machines, animals, harvest, and finances, and letting an AI-assisted builder generate the tables, forms, and automations to match. On **Jestor** , this runs through the **AI App Builder** .


Waiting for a developer to build a custom farm system means it goes live months after the need appeared, and the requirements have usually changed by then.


## What waiting for a developer costs


- Months of delay between the need and a working system
- Requirements changing before the first version is ready
- Ongoing dependence on the same developer for every change
- Budget spent on custom code for something no-code can handle
- Field teams working with paper while they wait


## How building without a developer works


- Describe your process in plain text to the **AI App Builder**
- It generates tables, forms, and first automations
- You refine the result to match your farm's details
- No one on your team writes or maintains code


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- The builder removes the wait for developer availability
- A working first version can exist in days, not months
- Non-technical staff can adjust the system as the farm grows
- This scales from a simple field log to a full farm management system


Developer-built system AI-assisted no-code system


Months of waiting, ongoing dependence Built in days, adjustable by the team


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Do I need technical skills to describe my farm?** No, plain language is enough to start. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can I edit the system after it is generated?** Yes, everything stays fully editable.


**Can it connect to WhatsApp, DocSign, and my ERP from the start?** Yes, native integrations with WhatsApp, DocSign, Omie, and Conta Azul can be added as needed.
